_README: The sheets ship no answer key, so these were determined by Claude, not taken from the source. `by` records that. Five of them are independently corroborated: each sheet's Hebrew mnemonic title encodes one of its answers (satellite, docile, abandon, advocate, appropriate), and those five match. Indices are 0-based.

sheet-1:1.note: EFSMI is the abbreviation of the institute's name

sheet-1:8.note: corroborated by the sheet's title יא סאטל בחלל -> satellite

sheet-2:4.note: 'a dubious character' is the set collocation; 'doubtful' describes a person's belief, not their appearance

sheet-2:8.note: corroborated by the sheet's title דוסילה חמוד -> docile

sheet-3:1.note: corroborated by the sheet's title אבא עם בנדנה -> abandon

sheet-3:5.note: hoard = store up; 'heard' and 'herald' are sound-alike distractors

sheet-4:1.note: corroborated by the sheet's title עו"ד א. בוקדו -> advocate

sheet-4:5.note: inhabit = live in; inhale/inhibit/inherit are sound-alike distractors

sheet-5:1.note: corroborated by the sheet's title מתאים לי אפרופו -> appropriate

sheet-5:3.note: erect a statue; 'erupted' is the sound-alike distractor

sheet-5:8.note: 'but only ___' signals a small degree, which rules out substantially and significantly
